channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Paul Douglas: My eyes are wide open to Boundary Waters threats
item.description: Pending legislation would turn a federal “no” on mining in the Boundary Waters into a congressional “proceed.”

item.title: Wondering what to do indoors with kids on a cold day? Visit one of these indoor Twin Cities playgrounds.
item.description: We tested 10 municipal play areas around the metro that get kids’ energy out for $10 or less.

item.title: Analysis: Another leap for Ant? Wolves’ Anthony Edwards is improving his game in Year 6.
item.description: The three-time All-Star appears to be having a growth spurt, as evidenced again by his career-best 55 points in San Antonio.

item.title: Jacob Frey, Liz Collin raise national profile through TV news
item.description: News outlets are turning to local personalities in the wake of the ICE shooting.

item.title: Twin Cities small business owners say Amazon’s AI lists their products without consent
item.description: Minnesota jewelry designer Emily Johnson is among those upset with Amazon over its new AI feature, which uses product images and descriptions from their websites.

item.title: Allegations of racial profiling of U.S. citizens on the rise as ICE surge expands in Minnesota
item.description: People of color describe being stopped, questioned or detained by immigration agents despite being U.S. citizens, raising civil liberties concerns.

item.title: Live: DHS Secretary Noem says federal order limiting use of force ‘didn’t change anything’ for agents
item.description: About 1,500 active-duty Army paratroopers have been put on alert for a possible deployment to Minnesota, ABC News reported.

item.title: Justice Department says it has no plans to investigate ICE agent who killed Renee Good and confirms Walz, Frey probe
item.description: Frey and the governor’s office both said Sunday that the DOJ has not contacted them about the investigation.

item.title: A state and city on edge faces another threat from Trump to send in 1,500 troops
item.description: But at Sunday church services, brunches and TV appearances, Minnesotans show resolve.

item.title: ‘We don’t want to be like Minneapolis’: Feelings on ICE surge reveal deep divide across state
item.description: As the U.S. Department of Homeland Security’s immigration enforcement stirs up the Twin Cities, ideological fault lines are appearing between the metro and greater Minnesota.
